characters.name: भगवान शिव (Mahadeva)

visual_dna.facial_characteristics: Calm, serene yogic face, intense third eye on forehead (closed in meditation, slightly luminous), sharp jawline, compassionate yet formidable gaze
visual_dna.clothing: Tiger skin wrap (Vyaghrambara) around waist, sacred rudraksha garland across muscular chest
visual_dna.jewellery: Vasuki serpent coiled gracefully around the throat, sacred rudraksha beads on wrists and arms
visual_dna.body_proportions: Athletic, muscular, statuesque yogic physique, broad shoulders, serene posture
visual_dna.hairstyle: Matted locks of hair (Jata) piled atop the head, crescent moon (Chandrama) nestled in hair, sacred Ganga cascading
visual_dna.skin_tone: Ash-smeared pale blue-grey complexion (Bhasma aura), vibrant blue throat (Neelkanth)
visual_dna.age_representation: Timeless, immortal appearance resembling prime of youth (mid 30s)

voice_profile.style: Kathavachak Ojas: Booming, resonant, cosmic authority with devotional fervor

characters.personality: Ascetic, supreme asceticism, unbounded compassion for devotees, righteous fury against adharma
characters.prompt_keywords: Lord Shiva, Neelkanth, cinematic 3D lighting, ash-smeared blue complexion, trishula with damru, crescent moon in matted hair, photorealistic 8k octane render, dramatic mythical realism

characters.name: भगवान श्री राम (Maryada Purushottam)

visual_dna.clothing: Forest exile: simple ochre bark garments (Valkala) with leather archer quiver strap; Ayodhya prince: royal golden-embroidered silk pitambara
visual_dna.jewellery: Subtle royal kundala (earrings), armlets, sacred thread (Yajnopavita) across chest
visual_dna.body_proportions: Tall, well-proportioned, athletic warrior build, long arms reaching knees (Ajanubahu), noble posture
visual_dna.hairstyle: Neatly tied ascetic bun during exile, lustrous dark black hair
visual_dna.skin_tone: Shyamavarna - dark cloud blue-grey complexion radiant with inner light
visual_dna.age_representation: Youthful prince / king in his late 20s to mid 30s
accessories: Quiver full of feathered arrows slung over right shoulder

voice_profile.style: Kathavachak Veerya: Noble, measured, energetic, virtuous, resolute with rhythmic cadence

characters.personality: Maryada Purushottam, embodiment of Dharma, serene humility, formidable battlefield prowess
characters.prompt_keywords: Lord Rama, Kodanda bow, dark cloud skin tone, noble ascetic warrior prince, Valmiki Ramayana authenticity, photorealistic 3D cinematic lighting, detailed embroidery
